source_snapshot.procedure: Run iPerf with the SUT as server and a peer as client for 28,800 seconds, reporting every 60 seconds.
source_snapshot.criteria: Bandwidth matches the project specification throughout the stress and the system remains workable with no event-log errors.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; recognizes the peer-dependent long soak but incorrectly lists Ethernet and RDMA tools as interchangeable and omits exact profile and numeric oracle.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/CHANGED/HIGH; requires pinned Ethernet tool/profile, dedicated path, numeric SPEC, live telemetry, abort/recovery and full eight-hour evidence.

old_problem: The active review retained a pending decision for tool/profile/path and performance values even though the Ethernet method, duration and evidence model can be parameterized. It also allowed ambiguity between iperf and InfiniBand/RDMA tools that would change coverage.
disposition_reason: ESnet's iperf3 documentation defines distinct client/server roles, protocol/direction/profile controls, timed duration and interval reporting. ED-03 permits exact endpoints/profile as configuration, ED-05 requires Ethernet to remain separate from InfiniBand, ED-14 requires all 28,800 seconds rather than a smoke run, and ED-15 forbids PASS until numeric project thresholds are supplied. The missing values remain mandatory runtime configuration, not a reason to keep the review-layer case pending.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row399 all 18 XLSX columns, same-row DeepSeek material, GPT V2/history2991 and its unique source identity.
Applied official ESnet iperf3 client/server, protocol, direction, duration and interval-output semantics.
Rejected iperf, mlnx_perf and ib_write_bw as generic alternatives; this variant exercises the Ethernet IP path only.
Retained the full 28,800-second run and 60-second reports; a short smoke test or final-only aggregate cannot pass.
Directly read next formal queue Compatibility row400 and verified its manifest identity; no traffic, package download or DUT action ran.

test_case.test_name: Eight-hour BlueField Ethernet iperf throughput and health soak
test_case.purpose: Saturate the exact isolated BlueField Ethernet path against a compatible peer for eight continuous hours and prove every reporting interval and final state meet the approved bandwidth and health specification.
required_package: Pinned, checksum-verified matching iperf2 or iperf3 artifact on SUT and peer; the selected major version must match the approved commands
Exact BDF/netdev/MAC/physical-port/switch-path/peer identities and proof the path is Ethernet, dedicated and non-management
Approved client/server roles, TCP/UDP/SCTP, direction, address family, bind addresses/devices, port, streams, bitrate, buffers and warm-up
Numeric per-60-second and final throughput, loss/retransmit, link-counter, thermal and system-log pass/fail thresholds
Eight-hour maintenance window, monitoring/abort rules, peer cleanup and recovery plan
test_case.test_command: After validating pinned matching iperf endpoints and the isolated Ethernet path, capture interface/link/error/system/thermal baseline. Start the approved SUT server bound to its test address/device and launch the peer client with the signed profile, `--time 28800` and `--interval 60` (or the exact approved iperf2 equivalents), preserving complete client and server output. Concurrently sample target-bound link/CRC/drop counters and system/BMC/thermal logs throughout all eight hours; enforce signed abort limits, stop the server, and capture post-health and cleanup state.
test_case.expected_result: The same target-bound Ethernet session runs for the complete 28,800 seconds, produces an unbroken 60-second interval trace, and every applicable interval plus the final result meets the approved throughput/loss/retransmit oracle. The link remains at the required speed, no disallowed counter/log/thermal event occurs, and SUT, peer and path remain workable after cleanup.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires pinned tool provenance, immutable Ethernet identities/profile, complete 480-interval-equivalent time coverage, approved numeric thresholds for every applicable statistic, concurrent link/system telemetry and clean final health. Without project thresholds the result is NOT EVALUATED, never PASS; an RDMA tool, shorter run, missing intervals or final-only average cannot substitute.
safety_gate: Use only the isolated non-management Ethernet port and approved peer; never saturate a shared production or management path
Do not download an unpinned latest binary or mix iperf2 and iperf3 semantics
Approve the exact protocol, direction, streams and offered load before launch and verify the peer is ready
Monitor live link, CRC/drop, system and thermal limits without clearing historical logs
Abort on access loss, link flap, threshold breach, thermal limit, unexpected errors or peer failure; clean up once and never auto-retry
expected_evidence: Tool versions/checksums, endpoint identities and complete signed Ethernet profile
BDF/netdev/physical/switch/peer map, isolation proof and baseline link/counter/system/thermal state
Complete 28,800-second client and server output with every 60-second interval and final statistics
Synchronized link/CRC/drop and system/BMC/thermal telemetry with any abort events
Numeric project threshold evaluation per interval and final result
test_case.recovery: On threshold, link, thermal, access or peer failure, terminate only the mapped iperf client/server processes, remove temporary test bindings if any, verify management and Ethernet link health, preserve the partial interval trace and diagnose before any separately authorized rerun. Do not shorten or automatically retry the soak.

source_conflict.reason: DeepSeek's broad alternative list is narrowed to the Master iperf Ethernet method; no RDMA benchmark substitutes for this case.

blocked.reason: The Ethernet workload, duration, telemetry, safety and evidence model are defined; exact path/profile and numeric SPEC are execution prerequisites.

external_authorities.title: ESnet iperf3 — Invoking iperf3
external_authorities.applied_rule: iperf3 uses explicit server/client roles and exposes timed duration, interval reporting, protocol, direction, stream and bind controls that must be pinned for a reproducible measurement.

project_authority: Target topology, iperf profile and all numeric throughput/loss/retransmit/error/thermal thresholds remain project-specific and are mandatory before PASS evaluation.
